aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 10.2.2.3, 10.2.2.4 and 10.2.2.5 source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_108.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 215 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. All 20 scoped base units are newly accounted because no numbered item falls in this scope; R1034 through R1041 and C1016 through C1034 all live in 10.2.2.2, which was verified independently rather than taken from the parallel batch107 author. 64 new facets remain pending. This packet and batch107 were authored in parallel from the same base, splitting 10.2.2 between them, so the ownership boundary was the main risk; it was checked in both directions and found free of duplication and of gaps, including the fine split whereby bounds remapping effects in p8 through p10 are owned here while bounds syntax and count constraints stay with 10.2.2.2. 10.2.2.5 yields zero requirements and zero facets because it is examples, with both base units and all three fine units still accounted. Three permissions are recorded, all in 10.2.2.4 p3, where the pure, simple and elemental-intrinsic target exceptions are allowed exceptions rather than obligations. The attribution table was verified word by word because every row cites a shall from a paragraph rather than from a numbered constraint, including the p7 VOLATILE if-and-only-if family, the three separate p8 families, and the opposite implicit-interface pairs of 10.2.2.4 p5. Pointer discipline was verified, and the unobservability claim is scoped to undefined association status only rather than overbroad: conforming controls may still check parameter values, association, bounds, extents or procedure calls wherever the source rule requires a defined state. Bounds evidence is non-vacuous by construction, using nondefault lower bounds and remapped shapes that differ from the target shape. Several 10.2.2.4 facets depend on unregistered Clause 15 characteristics, interface and host-instance material and cannot be implemented until it is registered. No pointer assignment execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
